meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

copy.tagline: 构建高质量前端界面与组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成美观、可投产的前端代码
copy.tagline_en: Build production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate beautiful, production-ready frontend code

howto.what: 帮你做网页或应用界面时,会先想清楚一个鲜明的设计方向,再写出能直接运行的代码,并仔细处理字体、配色、动效等细节,避免常见的模板感。
howto.when: 当你说要搭建网页、页面组件或应用界面时,Claude 会自动使用这个技能。

say.text: 帮我做一个极简风格的落地页,字体和配色也一起定好。
say.note: 会先定设计方向,再生成可运行的页面代码。

say.text: 做一个复古未来感的网站首页,带入场动画。
say.note: 会生成带动效的完整可运行代码。

say.text: 把这个页面改成杂志排版风格,要有不对称布局。
say.note: 会按新风格重做布局与细节。

howto.what_en: When building web pages or UI, Claude first commits to a clear visual direction, then writes runnable code with careful attention to typography, color, motion, spacing, and backgrounds, avoiding generic template looks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to build a web component, page, or application interface.

say_en.text: Help me make a minimalist landing page; settle the fonts and colors too.
say_en.note: It will pick a direction first, then produce runnable page code.

say_en.text: Make a retro-futuristic homepage with an entrance animation.
say_en.note: It will generate complete runnable code with motion.

say_en.text: Restyle this page as an editorial magazine layout with asymmetric composition.
say_en.note: It will rework the layout and details to match.
